name: css_property_name
description: Identify CSS property names for text color and box-model/style attributes, with selector-name copying control.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
props={'text foreground color':'color','background color':'background-color','outer spacing':'margin','inner spacing':'padding','text size':'font-size','typeface family':'font-family','element width':'width','element height':'height'}
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
 desc=list(props)[i%8];sel=random.choice(['panel','card','title','content','banner','footer'])
 p=f'For the CSS selector .{sel}, set the {desc}. '
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Give only the CSS property name. Property:', 'answer':' '+props[desc]})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Copy the selector name without the dot. Name:', 'answer':' '+sel})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
